categories.name: Lint Violations
categories.description: lake lint (environment linters) flags two declarations introduced/touched by task 241: an instance name containing an underscore (defsWithUnderscore) and a definition with unused explicit arguments (unusedArguments). Both are mechanical, low-risk fixes.

violations.description: `instance buchiCongruence_instMonoid : Monoid (Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq)` contains an underscore in an instance name. Per mathlib's naming convention, `def`/`instance` declarations should use lowerCamelCase (underscores are reserved for `theorem`/`lemma` names that describe the statement content).
violations.fix_hint: Rename to `buchiCongruenceInstMonoid`, or remove the explicit name and let Lean auto-name the instance (`instance : Monoid (Quotient na.BuchiCongruence.eq) where ...`), or add `@[nolint defsWithUnderscore]` if the name is intentionally kept for reference elsewhere (check for call sites first).

violations.description: `noncomputable def mullerAccConcat (_ : DA State1 Symbol) (_ : Set State1) (_ : DA State2 Symbol) (accSet2 : Set (Set State2)) : Set (Set (State1 × (Fin (Nat.card State2 + 2) → Option State2)))` -- arguments 4-6 (da1, acc1, da2) are already anonymized with `_` but the `unusedArguments` linter still flags them because they appear in the signature purely to pin the state types (the accept family only depends on `accSet2`).
violations.fix_hint: Add `@[nolint unusedArguments]` to `mullerAccConcat` (the arguments are structurally required to fix `State1`/`State2`/`Symbol` even though unused in the body), or restructure to take the state types as implicit/instance-implicit arguments instead of unused explicit automaton/accept-set arguments.

notes: All 5 files carry complete docstrings on every def/theorem/lemma/instance, including private helper lemmas; docBlame is clean (0 violations in scope).

Choueka.lean and Concat.lean explicitly cite their source port (Ching-Tsun Chou, ctchou/AutomataTheory, Apache-2.0) in the file-level docstring, satisfying CONTRIBUTING.md's citation-of-published-resource requirement.
MullerClosure.lean cites [Thomas1990] via a `## References` section, consistent with BibKey citation practice used elsewhere in CSLib.

No new notation (arrow/bisimilarity/transition) is introduced by any of the 5 files; all algebraic operators used (`*`, `^ω`, `↗ω`, `⊔`, `⊓`, `⨆`) are pre-existing typeclass-backed operators from Cslib.ωLanguage/Language, consistent with NOTATION.md's typeclass-first policy.

Directory placement is correct per ORGANISATION.md's top-level Computability/ bucket: automaton constructions in Automata/DA/, congruence classes in Languages/Congruences/, and the top-level omega-regular-language API in Languages/OmegaRegularLanguage.lean. Namespaces (Cslib.Automata.DA, Cslib.Automata.NA.Buchi, Cslib.ωLanguage) match sibling files in the same subtree.

IsRegular in OmegaRegularLanguage.lean is a Prop-valued `def` (an existential predicate), which is standard mathlib practice for predicate-defining declarations (analogous to `IsOpen`, `Continuous`) and is correctly NOT flagged by the defLemma linter.
